V8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
S is agreement between a three-replicate average and one held-out replicate of one
dexamethasone series in one cell line. Nothing here measures the true transcription
rate, so a higher S is a less contaminated estimator, not a verified one.
If SMOOTH wins, part of that win is arithmetic: smoothing correlates neighbouring
intervals, so pooled Pearson over intervals rises even when no single gene is
estimated better. V7 is the only gate that separates the two, because a forward
task cannot be helped by having smeared the answer into its own input.
The negative controls for RUV are chosen by small plateau, which selects genes that
are quiet OR poorly measured; if the component lives mostly in quiet genes then RUV
estimates it well and if it lives in responders then RUV cannot see it at all.
